accounts.name: programConfig
docs: Global program configuration: the authority that may update it, the
treasury that collects multisig creation fees, and the fee itself.

accounts.name: multisig
docs: A multisig: consensus parameters plus the sorted member roster.
Members live in two parallel compact tails (`member_keys` sorted ascending,
`member_permissions` aligned by index) so the account only pays rent for
active members. A member's bit index in a proposal's vote masks is its
position in `member_keys`.

fields.name: createKey
docs: Key that seeds the multisig PDA and namespaces proposals.

fields.name: configAuthority
docs: An autonomous multisig (default key) changes config through proposals;
a controlled multisig defers to this key via
[`MultisigInstruction::ConfigAuthorityExecute`].

fields.name: rentCollector
docs: Where terminal proposal rent is reclaimed; the default address
disables collection.

fields.name: threshold
docs: Signatures required to approve a proposal.

fields.name: timelock
docs: Seconds between approval and permissible execution.

fields.name: ttl
docs: Lifetime stamped onto new proposals; zero disables expiry.

fields.name: transactionIndex
docs: Last allocated proposal index; counts both kinds.

fields.name: staleTransactionIndex
docs: Proposals at or below this index predate the latest consensus change.

fields.name: memberRoster
docs: Sorted member roster as concatenated 32-byte addresses, parallel to
`member_permissions`. Raw bytes keep the generated CLI clients
renderable while the compact tail still charges rent per member.

fields.name: memberPermissions
docs: Permission masks, parallel to the roster.

accounts.name: proposal
docs: A proposal: vote state and payload in one account.
The payload is stored exactly as the wire format the program re-parses at
execution, validated once at creation, so there is a single encoding of a
vault message or config action stream between creation and execution.

fields.name: index
docs: The index this proposal occupies in the multisig's namespace.

fields.name: kind
docs: [`KIND_VAULT`] or [`KIND_CONFIG`].

fields.name: vaultIndex
docs: Vault index for vault proposals; ignored for config proposals.

fields.name: vaultBump
docs: Canonical bump of the vault PDA for vault proposals.

fields.name: status
docs: Lifecycle status; see the `STATUS_*` constants.

fields.name: statusAt
docs: When the current status was set. For approved proposals this anchors
the timelock.

fields.name: expiresAt
docs: When the proposal dies; zero means it never expires.

fields.name: approvedMask
docs: Approval bitmask over the multisig's sorted member list.

fields.name: rejectedMask
docs: Rejection bitmask over the multisig's sorted member list.

fields.name: ephemeralBumps
docs: Ephemeral signer bumps, one per ephemeral PDA, for vault proposals.

fields.name: message
docs: Encoded vault message ([`MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES`] cap).

fields.name: actions
docs: Encoded config action stream ([`MAX_ACTIONS_BYTES`] cap).

accounts.name: spendingLimit
docs: A member-scoped allowance to spend from a vault without a vote.

fields.name: vaultIndex
docs: Vault the allowance draws from.

fields.name: vaultBump
docs: Bump of the vault PDA for `[SEED_VAULT, multisig, vault_index]`,
recorded at creation so draws derive it with one address computation
instead of an on-chain search.

fields.name: mint
docs: The default address means SOL; anything else is an SPL mint.

fields.name: amount
docs: Allowance per period, in native mint decimals.

fields.name: remainingAmount
docs: Remaining allowance in the current period.

fields.name: lastReset
docs: When the current period started.

fields.name: period
docs: Reset period; see the `PERIOD_*` constants.

fields.name: members
docs: Members allowed to draw on this limit, as concatenated addresses.

fields.name: destinations
docs: Allowed destinations as concatenated addresses; empty means
unrestricted.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury that collects the creation fee; pass the program's own
address as a filler when the fee is zero.

accounts.name: memberAccounts
docs: The founding members, sorted by address; `member_permissions` indexes
into this list positionally.

accounts.name: legacyCreateKey
docs: The legacy multisig's `create_key`: its holder authorizes the import,
which is what stops a fabricated legacy account from adopting a roster
of keys that never consented.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury that collects the creation fee; absent when the fee is zero.

accounts.name: messageAccounts
docs: The message's account keys, in message order. Accounts the message
marks writable must also be writable in this instruction.

accounts.name: spendingLimitAccounts
docs: Spending limit accounts referenced by add/remove spending-limit
actions, in any order.

accounts.name: spendingLimitAccounts
docs: Spending limit accounts referenced by add/remove spending-limit
actions, in any order.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The vault PDA: SOL source or SPL transfer authority.

accounts.name: destination
docs: SOL destination, or the destination token account for SPL.

accounts.name: vaultTokenAccount
docs: SPL source token account; absent for SOL.

accounts.name: mint
docs: SPL mint; absent for SOL.

accounts.name: tokenProgram
docs: SPL token program; absent for SOL.

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: System program; absent for SPL.
